results.title: Palestinians in Gaza scavenge trash for things to burn to cook meals, in photos
results.description: DEIR AL-BALAH, Gaza Strip (AP) — Hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians in Gaza make the difficult choice every day between digging into garbage dumps for combustible materials to help cook their meals or crowding around the territory's scarce charity...
